name: Mini Notes Summarizer
description: Exposes `summarize_notes`, which asks the host LLM to summarize the Mini Notes app's notes via reverse sampling/createMessage.
_comment: tool_id/type/enabled are read by `anna-app dev` and `anna-app executa dev`; `type: node` launches `node <package.json bin[tool_id]>` = src/index.js. The `binary` profile points at the archives produced by `npm run package:binary` / the release workflow (one per platform key).
